title: Ops evidence summary
description: Machine-readable summary written by the project verifier (-ReportDir) and finalized by scripts/ops/finalize-evidence.sh for each Ops task.

task.description: Task identifier derived from the report directory basename (e.g. ops-01)

commit.description: Bound to the reviewed task commit SHA by finalize-evidence; null before finalization

started_at.description: Verifier run start time, UTC ISO 8601

finished_at.description: Verifier run end time, UTC ISO 8601

commands.description: Executed gate commands in order; stops at the first failure

exit_codes.description: Exit code per executed command; must pair with commands

tool_versions.description: Tool version strings for the tools invoked during the run

evidence.description: Paths of the raw evidence/log files produced by the run

evidence_sha256.description: Added by finalize-evidence: SHA-256 of each referenced evidence file

redaction_checked.description: Attestation that logs were reviewed for secrets/PII before sharing

blockers.description: Outstanding release blockers recorded for the task
